purpose: Toggleable context meter: presents tokens used and percentage of the resolved context window with provenance labels; resolves the window in a hook and refreshes it after each chat.done.

public_api.name: ContextMeter
public_api.signature: (props: { fill: ContextFill | undefined; window: Pick<ResolvedContextWindow,'source'|'stale'> | undefined; wide: boolean }) => JSX.Element
public_api.description:
Presentational. data-testid=context-meter, data-level ok|warn|error (absent while unknown/loading). Renders ' tokens ·

%', '—' when unknown, provenance word for estimated/assumed/stale. Never renders the window size.

public_api.name: useContextWindow
public_api.signature: (deps: { enabled: boolean; conversation: Conversation|null|undefined; model: OllamaModel|undefined; remembered: Record<string,number>; rememberContextWindow: (provider, model, resolved) => void; completedCount: number }) => { window: ResolvedContextWindow|undefined; fill: ContextFill|undefined }
public_api.description: Fetches /models/runtime (then metadata once per model, only when runtime reports metadata) when enabled, on model change and after each chat.done; resolves via resolveContextWindow; calls rememberContextWindow after every resolve; discards superseded responses.

public_api.name: SidebarState.showContextMeter
public_api.description: Persisted preference, toggled by a 'Show context meter' row in the Client settings section.

public_api.name: useChatGeneration().completedCount
public_api.description: Incremented once per generation that ends in chat.done.
